title: RTPS: Enable dissection of PLAIN_CDR2
description:
PLAIN_CDR2 is exactly the same as PLAIN_CDR, just with some different alignments for certain types.  (DDS-XTypes 7.4.2)

Also fixes a bug dissecting Float128 types with PLAIN_CDR - they were being aligned based on their length (16) instead of 8.  (DDS-XTypes 7.4.1.1.1)
